category: 🏺 Living Artifact · Hardship Ball & Chain Formula
title: HSBall 솔로 #168 · 폴리네시안여신 · Portuguese azulejo tile · 맥주통 쇠공 등에 지기(옆모습) · a glossy near-black wine lip
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep burgundy-black shadow smudged heavily beneath both eyes, sharp black liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a glossy near-black wine lip, sharply contoured cheekbones, a hint of despair, her eyes softly worried and shining, her brow lightly drawn together, natural soft black hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The color has dulled and cracked along her ribs, waist and thighs, rubbed bare in thin streaks over her shoulders and the backs of her knees so her skin shows through the worn paint. Soot darkens her nose, cheeks and chin, damp strands of hair stick to her cheeks and neck, dirt is ground into her knees, calves and elbows, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.

Restraints: A huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a beer keg rides on her back, held by two thick chains of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that loop over her shoulders and run down her back to the ball, the chains pulled taut by its weight. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links.

Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, bent far forward under the weight of the iron ball on her back, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
